jp: 禁術により生ける屍と化してまで現世を生きる古代の王。時折間抜けな遺跡荒らしを招待状でおびき寄せ、ピラミッドを守る兵士を補充している。
jp_grezzo: "禁術により生ける屍と化してまで現世を生きる古代の王。時折間抜けな遺跡荒らしを招待状でおびき寄せ、ピラミッドを守る兵士を補充している。"
en: An ancient king who lives in this world until the forbidden arts turn him into a living corpse. He occasionally lures dumb grave robbers with invitations and replenishes the soldiers guarding the pyramids.
en_grezzo: "An ancient king who lives in this world until the forbidden arts turn him into a living corpse. He occasionally lures dumb grave robbers with invitations and replenishes the soldiers guarding the pyramids."
it: Un re antico che, per restare a vivere in questo mondo, con un'arte proibita si è ridotto a cadavere che cammina. Ogni tanto attira con un invito qualche sciocco che saccheggia le rovine, e così rimpiazza i soldati che sorvegliano la piramide.

jp: 古の昔に栄えた一文明、貴の者たちが安置された棺の周囲にダミーとして配置されたもののなれの果て。入れられた死体が棺と融合してしまっている。
jp_grezzo: "古の昔に栄えた一文明、貴の者たちが安置された棺の周囲にダミーとして配置されたもののなれの果て。入れられた死体が棺と融合してしまっている。"
en: The end result of a civilisation that flourished in ancient times, where noblemen were placed as dummies around a coffin in which they were enshrined. The corpse in which they were placed has fused with the coffin.
en_grezzo: "The end result of a civilisation that flourished in ancient times, where noblemen were placed as dummies around a coffin in which they were enshrined. The corpse in which they were placed has fused with the coffin."
it: Quel che resta dei sarcofagi che, in una civiltà fiorita nell'antichità, venivano messi come esca intorno a quello dove riposavano i nobili. Il cadavere che ci avevano messo dentro si è fuso con il sarcofago.

jp: 群れを作って人を襲う小人。彼らは独自の言語を話し地下にゴブリンだけの社会を築いている。トロールとは言葉が通じないもののウマが合うらしく、仲が良い。
jp_grezzo: "群れを作って人を襲う小人。彼らは独自の言語を話し地下にゴブリンだけの社会を築いている。トロールとは言葉が通じないもののウマが合うらしく、仲が良い。"
en: Goblins attack people in swarms. They speak their own language and have established an underground goblin-only society. Although they do not speak the same language as trolls, they seem to get on well with them.
en_grezzo: "Goblins attack people in swarms. They speak their own language and have established an underground goblin-only society. Although they do not speak the same language as trolls, they seem to get on well with them."
it: Un piccolo essere che assale gli uomini in gruppo. Parlano una lingua tutta loro e sottoterra si sono costruiti una società di soli goblin. Con i troll non si capiscono a parole, eppure pare che vadano d'accordo e stiano in buoni rapporti.

jp: ゴブリン族の中で近接戦闘の訓練を積んだ者。心眼で的確に急所を狙う上、その筋骨隆々の体は見た目以上に力を発揮する。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の中で近接戦闘の訓練を積んだ者。心眼で的確に急所を狙う上、その筋骨隆々の体は見た目以上に力を発揮する。"
en: Trained in melee combat among the goblin tribe. He uses his eye of mind to accurately aim for the vital spot, and his muscular body shows more strength than it appears.
en_grezzo: "Trained in melee combat among the goblin tribe. He uses his eye of mind to accurately aim for the vital spot, and his muscular body shows more strength than it appears."
it: Fra i goblin, quelli che si sono addestrati al corpo a corpo. Con l'occhio della mente punta il punto debole con precisione, e quel corpo tutto muscoli tira fuori più forza di quanta ne dia a vedere.

jp: ゴブリン族の呪術師。この魔物が発見されたとき、ゴブリンにも精霊や神などを信仰する慣習があるということに世界は驚愕した。一応、人間たちの見よう見まねであることが後に判明したのだが。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の呪術師。この魔物が発見されたとき、ゴブリンにも精霊や神などを信仰する慣習があるということに世界は驚愕した。一応、人間たちの見よう見まねであることが後に判明したのだが。"
en: Goblin tribe sorcerer. When this monster was discovered, the world was astonished to learn that goblins also had a practice of believing in spirits and gods. It was later discovered that they were, in a manner of speaking, imitating the humans.
en_grezzo: "Goblin tribe sorcerer. When this monster was discovered, the world was astonished to learn that goblins also had a practice of believing in spirits and gods. It was later discovered that they were, in a manner of speaking, imitating the humans."
it: Lo stregone della stirpe dei goblin. Quando questo mostro fu scoperto, il mondo restò sbalordito che anche i goblin avessero l'usanza di venerare gli spiriti e le divinità. Poi si scoprì che, in fondo, non facevano che scimmiottare gli uomini.

jp: ゴブリン族の中で魔力に長けた者。地味ながら魔法の矢で獲物の確実に追い詰めて行く、縁の下の力持ち。魔法が使えることを鼻にかけているフシがある。
jp_grezzo: "ゴブリン族の中で魔力に長けた者。地味ながら魔法の矢で獲物の確実に追い詰めて行く、縁の下の力持ち。魔法が使えることを鼻にかけているフシがある。"
en: A goblin tribe member who is skilled in magic. He is a simple but powerful man behind the scenes who uses magic arrows to hunt down his prey with confidence. He seems to have a nose to taking advantage of his magical abilities.
en_grezzo: "A goblin tribe member who is skilled in magic. He is a simple but powerful man behind the scenes who uses magic arrows to hunt down his prey with confidence. He seems to have a nose to taking advantage of his magical abilities."
it: Fra i goblin, quello portato per la forza magica. Senza dare nell'occhio mette la preda alle strette con la freccia magica, un colpo dopo l'altro: è la forza che lavora dietro le quinte. Pare che di saper usare la magia se ne vanti un po' troppo.

jp: 現在は何処かに封印されているという赤き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌は元の容を留めぬ程に焼け爛れている。
jp_grezzo: "現在は何処かに封印されているという赤き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌は元の容を留めぬ程に焼け爛れている。"
en: A person who has become fascinated by and worships the red devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by his dressing gown, is so burnt that it has lost all trace of its original appearance.
en_grezzo: "A person who has become fascinated by and worships the red devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by his dressing gown, is so burnt that it has lost all trace of its original appearance. "
it: Uno a cui il demone rosso, che adesso dicono sigillato da qualche parte, ha rapito il cuore e che ha finito per adorarlo. Il volto nascosto sotto la veste è bruciato al punto da non conservare più niente della forma di prima.

jp: 現在は何処かに封印されているという青き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌はおぞましく凍り付き、眼球全体が碧く濁っている。
jp_grezzo: "現在は何処かに封印されているという青き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝するようになった者。ローブに隠された貌はおぞましく凍り付き、眼球全体が碧く濁っている。"
en: A person who has become enthralled by and worships the blue devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by a dressing gown, is horribly frozen and his eyeballs are entirely clouded with blue.
en_grezzo: "A person who has become enthralled by and worships the blue devil, which is now sealed away somewhere. His face, hidden by a dressing gown, is horribly frozen and his eyeballs are entirely clouded with blue. "
it: Uno a cui il demone blu, che adesso dicono sigillato da qualche parte, ha rapito il cuore e che ha finito per adorarlo. Il volto nascosto sotto la veste è congelato in modo orribile, e il bulbo degli occhi è tutto torbido di azzurro.

jp: 人に飼い慣らされた熊。芸も覚えているが披露する機会を与えられる者は少ない。捨てられた者は野生化し、群れで人を襲う。
jp_grezzo: "人に飼い慣らされた熊。芸も覚えているが披露する機会を与えられる者は少ない。捨てられた者は野生化し、群れで人を襲う。"
en: A bear that has been tamed by people. They learn tricks, but few are given the opportunity to perform them. Those that are abandoned become wild and attack people in packs.
en_grezzo: "A bear that has been tamed by people. They learn tricks, but few are given the opportunity to perform them. Those that are abandoned become wild and attack people in packs."
it: Un orso addomesticato dagli uomini. Impara anche i numeri da spettacolo, ma pochi hanno l'occasione di mostrarli. Quelli che vengono abbandonati tornano selvatici e assalgono la gente in branco.

jp: 特に人間を好んで襲う狂暴な熊。別名はハイイログマであり、その名の通り体毛は灰色なのだが、たまに返り血で毛が赤く染まっている個体もいるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "特に人間を好んで襲う狂暴な熊。別名はハイイログマであり、その名の通り体毛は灰色なのだが、たまに返り血で毛が赤く染まっている個体もいるようだ。"
en: A rabid bear that particularly likes to attack humans. It is also known as the hylog bear, and as its name suggests, its body hair is grey, but occasionally some individuals seem to have their fur stained red by returned blood.
en_grezzo: "A rabid bear that particularly likes to attack humans. It is also known as the hylog bear, and as its name suggests, its body hair is grey, but occasionally some individuals seem to have their fur stained red by returned blood. "
it: Un orso feroce che ha una particolare preferenza per gli uomini. L'altro suo nome è orso grigio, e come dice il nome ha il pelo grigio, ma ogni tanto pare ci sia qualche esemplare che ce l'ha tinto di rosso dal sangue schizzato addosso.

jp: レム・イド時代に遺伝子復元技術によって復活したとされる、超古代生物。その肉は大昔から人間たちの糧となっていた。現在でもマンモスの肉は御馳走とされている。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド時代に遺伝子復元技術によって復活したとされる、超古代生物。その肉は大昔から人間たちの糧となっていた。現在でもマンモスの肉は御馳走とされている。"
en: A super-ancient creature that is believed to have been revived by genetic restoration technology during the Remido era. Its meat has fed humans since ancient times. Even today, mammoth meat is considered a delicacy.
en_grezzo: "A super-ancient creature that is believed to have been revived by genetic restoration technology during the Remido era. Its meat has fed humans since ancient times. Even today, mammoth meat is considered a delicacy."
it: Una creatura antichissima che, dicono, fu riportata in vita al tempo di Rehm-Ido con la tecnica che ricostruisce i geni. La sua carne è stata cibo per gli uomini fin dai tempi remoti, e ancora oggi la carne di mammut è considerata una leccornia.

jp: 斃れた戦士の無念が、打ち捨てられた鎧に宿り彷徨うようになった。誰かに破壊されない限り、果たせなかった敵を探し続ける。中身が空っぽなせいか、満たされないんだとか。
jp_grezzo: "斃れた戦士の無念が、打ち捨てられた鎧に宿り彷徨うようになった。誰かに破壊されない限り、果たせなかった敵を探し続ける。中身が空っぽなせいか、満たされないんだとか。"
en: The remorse of the dead warriors began to wander about in their cast-off armour. Unless someone destroys them, they continue to search for the enemy they could not defeat. They are not satisfied because they are empty inside.
en_grezzo: "The remorse of the dead warriors began to wander about in their cast-off armour. Unless someone destroys them, they continue to search for the enemy they could not defeat. They are not satisfied because they are empty inside."
it: Il rimpianto di un guerriero caduto si è annidato nell'armatura buttata via e ha cominciato a vagare. Se qualcuno non la distrugge continua a cercare il nemico che non è riuscita a battere. Sarà perché dentro è vuota, ma non si sente mai sazia.

jp: 斃れた戦士の邪念が主無き重層鎧に乗り移り、生命あるもの全てを敵とみなし、暴走した。打ち果たされた後も次の器を探して彷徨うことだろう。
jp_grezzo: "斃れた戦士の邪念が主無き重層鎧に乗り移り、生命あるもの全てを敵とみなし、暴走した。打ち果たされた後も次の器を探して彷徨うことだろう。"
en: The evil spirit of the dead warrior has taken over the masterless heavy-layered armour and has run amok, regarding everything that lives as an enemy. After being vanquished, they will continue to wander in search of the next vessel.
en_grezzo: "The evil spirit of the dead warrior has taken over the masterless heavy-layered armour and has run amok, regarding everything that lives as an enemy. After being vanquished, they will continue to wander in search of the next vessel. "
it: Il pensiero malvagio di un guerriero caduto è passato in un'armatura pesante rimasta senza padrone e si è scatenato, prendendo per nemico tutto quello che vive. Anche dopo essere stata abbattuta continuerà a vagare in cerca del prossimo contenitore.

jp: 古代の英雄の思念が投影された美しい鎧。己を凌駕する力の持ち主に出会うまで、戦いの愉悦に溺れ走り続ける。金でできているわけではないので鎧として見た時の価値はそこまで高くない。
jp_grezzo: "古代の英雄の思念が投影された美しい鎧。己を凌駕する力の持ち主に出会うまで、戦いの愉悦に溺れ走り続ける。金でできているわけではないので鎧として見た時の価値はそこまで高くない。"
en: A beautiful armour, projected with the thoughts of ancient heroes. It keeps running, drowning in the joys of battle, until it meets the owner of a power that surpasses its own. It is not made of gold, so its value as an armour is not that high.
en_grezzo: "A beautiful armour, projected with the thoughts of ancient heroes. It keeps running, drowning in the joys of battle, until it meets the owner of a power that surpasses its own. It is not made of gold, so its value as an armour is not that high."
it: Una bellissima armatura in cui si è proiettato il pensiero di un eroe antico. Corre e corre, ubriaca del piacere della battaglia, finché non incontra qualcuno con una forza che supera la sua. D'oro però non è fatta, e come armatura non vale poi molto.

jp: 不遇の死を迎え、埋葬される事なく朽ちた邪悪な騎士の怨念が取りついた鎧。衝動のままに死と悪阻を撒き散らす。間違っても着用してはいけない。
jp_grezzo: "不遇の死を迎え、埋葬される事なく朽ちた邪悪な騎士の怨念が取りついた鎧。衝動のままに死と悪阻を撒き散らす。間違っても着用してはいけない。"
en: Armour attached to the grudge of an evil knight who died an untimely death and decayed without burial. It spreads death and malice on impulse. Do not wear it by mistake.
en_grezzo: "Armour attached to the grudge of an evil knight who died an untimely death and decayed without burial. It spreads death and malice on impulse. Do not wear it by mistake."
it: Un'armatura in cui si è annidato il rancore di un cavaliere malvagio, morto di una morte ingiusta e marcito senza sepoltura. Sparge morte e nausea seguendo l'impulso. Guai a indossarla, nemmeno per sbaglio.

jp: 蛇の髪の毛をもつ。先祖は見たものを石に変える力を持っていたが、あまりにも日常生活において不便なため世代が進むにつれその力は退化。今では、一時的に相手の身をこわばらせる程度。
jp_grezzo: "蛇の髪の毛をもつ。先祖は見たものを石に変える力を持っていたが、あまりにも日常生活において不便なため世代が進むにつれその力は退化。今では、一時的に相手の身をこわばらせる程度。"
en: They have snake hair. Their ancestors had the power to turn what they saw into stone, but it was so inconvenient in their daily lives that the power degenerated over the generations. Now it only temporarily stiffens the opponent.
en_grezzo: "They have snake hair. Their ancestors had the power to turn what they saw into stone, but it was so inconvenient in their daily lives that the power degenerated over the generations. Now it only temporarily stiffens the opponent."
it: Ha serpenti al posto dei capelli. Gli antenati avevano il potere di trasformare in pietra quello che guardavano, ma nella vita di tutti i giorni era così scomodo che di generazione in generazione il potere si è ridotto. Adesso irrigidisce l'avversario, e solo per un poco.

jp: 髪の毛でもある蛇は一匹一匹が自我を持っており、ときおり本体と喧嘩している姿が目撃されている。脱皮の時期は頭がすごいことになる。蛇とのコンビネーションで相手を幻惑する。
jp_grezzo: "髪の毛でもある蛇は一匹一匹が自我を持っており、ときおり本体と喧嘩している姿が目撃されている。脱皮の時期は頭がすごいことになる。蛇とのコンビネーションで相手を幻惑する。"
en: Each one of these snakes-hair, is self-aware and has occasionally been seen fighting with the main body. During the moult season, their heads become amazing. The combination of the snakes and the snakes is used to disorientate the opponent.
en_grezzo: "Each one of these snakes-hair, is self-aware and has occasionally been seen fighting with the main body. During the moult season, their heads become amazing. The combination of the snakes and the snakes is used to disorientate the opponent."
it: I serpenti che le fanno da capelli hanno ciascuno una coscienza sua, e li si è visti più volte litigare con la padrona. Nella stagione della muta la testa diventa uno spettacolo. Confonde l'avversario giocando in combinazione con i suoi serpenti.

jp: 神の怒りを受けて怪物にされてしまった妹を見て抗議したところ、もう一人の妹ともども怪物にされてしまった女性がいた。その子孫のうちの一人。
jp_grezzo: "神の怒りを受けて怪物にされてしまった妹を見て抗議したところ、もう一人の妹ともども怪物にされてしまった女性がいた。その子孫のうちの一人。"
en: When she protested against seeing her sister turned into a monster by the wrath of God, she was turned into a monster along with her other sister. This is one of her descendants.
en_grezzo: "When she protested against seeing her sister turned into a monster by the wrath of God, she was turned into a monster along with her other sister. This is one of her descendants. "
it: C'era una donna che, vedendo la sorella trasformata in mostro dall'ira del dio, protestò, e per questo fu trasformata in mostro anche lei insieme all'altra sorella. Questa è una delle sue discendenti.

jp: 何処かの愛の神の力を得た魔物。その矢に貫かれると恋に落ち、語るべき言葉を失ってしまう。結構ドジで、普通の矢を放ってしまい目標をうっかり射殺することも。
jp_grezzo: "何処かの愛の神の力を得た魔物。その矢に貫かれると恋に落ち、語るべき言葉を失ってしまう。結構ドジで、普通の矢を放ってしまい目標をうっかり射殺することも。"
en: A monster that has gained the power of some love god. When pierced by its arrows, it falls in love and loses the words it should speak. He is quite a screw-up and sometimes accidentally shoots his target dead by releasing an ordinary arrow.
en_grezzo: "A monster that has gained the power of some love god. When pierced by its arrows, it falls in love and loses the words it should speak. He is quite a screw-up and sometimes accidentally shoots his target dead by releasing an ordinary arrow."
it: Un mostro che ha ottenuto la forza di un qualche dio dell'amore. Chi viene trafitto da quelle frecce si innamora e perde le parole che dovrebbe dire. È parecchio imbranato, e ogni tanto scocca una freccia normale e ammazza il bersaglio per sbaglio.

jp: 亡霊が宿り動き出した鎧。生ある者に対する呪いの言葉を呟き続けている。インテリア用の鎧に宿ってしまったために、意外なほど脆い。
jp_grezzo: "亡霊が宿り動き出した鎧。生ある者に対する呪いの言葉を呟き続けている。インテリア用の鎧に宿ってしまったために、意外なほど脆い。"
en: Armour in which ghosts dwell and move. It keeps muttering curses against the living. Because it has taken up residence in interior armour, it is surprisingly fragile.
en_grezzo: "Armour in which ghosts dwell and move. It keeps muttering curses against the living. Because it has taken up residence in interior armour, it is surprisingly fragile."
it: Un'armatura in cui si è annidato uno spettro e che ha cominciato a muoversi. Continua a mormorare parole di maledizione contro chi è vivo. Siccome si è annidato in un'armatura da arredamento, è sorprendentemente fragile.

jp: 恐竜は太古の昔に滅んだ種族だが旧文明の遺伝子技術で復元されたらしい。力強さと高い俊敏性を持ち、他の恐竜を捕食していたとされる。
jp_grezzo: "恐竜は太古の昔に滅んだ種族だが旧文明の遺伝子技術で復元されたらしい。力強さと高い俊敏性を持ち、他の恐竜を捕食していたとされる。"
en: Dinosaurs are a species that died out in prehistoric times but were apparently restored by the genetic technology of an old civilisation. They are said to have been powerful and highly agile, and to have preyed on other dinosaurs.
en_grezzo: "Dinosaurs are a species that died out in prehistoric times but were apparently restored by the genetic technology of an old civilisation. They are said to have been powerful and highly agile, and to have preyed on other dinosaurs. "
it: I dinosauri sono una stirpe estinta in tempi remotissimi, ma pare che la tecnica genetica della vecchia civiltà li abbia ricostruiti. Aveva forza e grande agilità, e si dice che predasse gli altri dinosauri.

jp: 半人半鳥の姦しい魔物。腕の代わりに鳥の翼を持つのだが、見た目ほど機敏な動きができるわけではない。その羽根をホウキにするのが流行ったが、現在は法律で禁止されている。
jp_grezzo: "半人半鳥の姦しい魔物。腕の代わりに鳥の翼を持つのだが、見た目ほど機敏な動きができるわけではない。その羽根をホウキにするのが流行ったが、現在は法律で禁止されている。"
en: A half-human, half-bird, fornicating monster. Instead of arms, they have bird wings, but they are not as agile as they appear. It was fashionable to use its wings as broomsticks, but this is now prohibited by law.
en_grezzo: "A half-human, half-bird, fornicating monster. Instead of arms, they have bird wings, but they are not as agile as they appear. It was fashionable to use its wings as broomsticks, but this is now prohibited by law."
it: Un mostro chiassoso, mezzo uomo e mezzo uccello. Al posto delle braccia ha ali da uccello, ma non è agile quanto sembra. Un tempo andava di moda farne scope con le penne, ma adesso la legge lo vieta.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。他の竜に比べるとあまり攻撃的ではないが、そのブレスは非常に強力であり油断はできない。雑食性だが草をよく食べる。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。他の竜に比べるとあまり攻撃的ではないが、そのブレスは非常に強力であり油断はできない。雑食性だが草をよく食べる。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They are less aggressive than other dragons, but their breath is very powerful and they cannot be underestimated. They are omnivorous but often eat grass.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They are less aggressive than other dragons, but their breath is very powerful and they cannot be underestimated. They are omnivorous but often eat grass."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. È meno aggressivo degli altri draghi, ma il suo soffio è potentissimo e non lo si può prendere alla leggera. È onnivoro, ma mangia spesso erba.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。体内に火炎袋と呼ばれる可燃性ガスの生成器官をもつ。うっかり吐いた炎で巣を燃やしてしまう個体も少なくない。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。体内に火炎袋と呼ばれる可燃性ガスの生成器官をもつ。うっかり吐いた炎で巣を燃やしてしまう個体も少なくない。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have a flammable gas-producing organ in their bodies called a flaming sac. Many individuals inadvertently burn their nests with the flames they exhale.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have a flammable gas-producing organ in their bodies called a flaming sac. Many individuals inadvertently burn their nests with the flames they exhale."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. Nel corpo ha un organo che produce un gas infiammabile, chiamato sacca di fuoco. Non sono pochi quelli che, senza volerlo, con la fiamma che sputano si bruciano il nido.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。冷媒の詰まった器官をもち、吸い込んだ空気から熱を奪い冷気に変える。そのため他のドラゴンと比べると実は体温が高いほうである。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。冷媒の詰まった器官をもち、吸い込んだ空気から熱を奪い冷気に変える。そのため他のドラゴンと比べると実は体温が高いほうである。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have organs filled with refrigerant, which take heat from the air they inhale and convert it into cold air. As a result, their body temperature is actually higher than that of other dragons.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have organs filled with refrigerant, which take heat from the air they inhale and convert it into cold air. As a result, their body temperature is actually higher than that of other dragons."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. Ha un organo pieno di refrigerante, che toglie il calore all'aria che respira e la trasforma in gelo. Per questo, a conti fatti, ha una temperatura del corpo più alta degli altri draghi.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。体内に静電気を生成する電気袋と呼ばれる器官が存在し、戦いの時には口から放電を行う。電気を使い切るとわざわざ雷に打たれにいく。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。体内に静電気を生成する電気袋と呼ばれる器官が存在し、戦いの時には口から放電を行う。電気を使い切るとわざわざ雷に打たれにいく。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have an organ in their bodies called an electric bag that produces static electricity, which they discharge from their mouths during battle. When they run out of electricity, they go out of their way to be struck by lightning.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. They have an organ in their bodies called an electric bag that produces static electricity, which they discharge from their mouths during battle. When they run out of electricity, they go out of their way to be struck by lightning."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. Nel corpo ha un organo che genera elettricità statica, chiamato sacca elettrica, e in battaglia scarica dalla bocca. Quando finisce l'elettricità va apposta a farsi colpire da un fulmine.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。その吐息は魔力を含んでおり、生者から生命力を奪う。どうやって冥界からやってきているのかは未だに不明。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。その吐息は魔力を含んでおり、生者から生命力を奪う。どうやって冥界からやってきているのかは未だに不明。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. Their breath contains magical powers and robs the living of their life force. How they come from the underworld is still unknown.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. Their breath contains magical powers and robs the living of their life force. How they come from the underworld is still unknown."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. Il suo alito contiene forza magica e ruba ai vivi la forza vitale. Come faccia ad arrivare dall'oltretomba non si sa ancora.

jp: エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。様々なエネルギー袋が融合しており、口からは混沌のブレスを吐く。好き嫌いがなく何でもよく食べるので飼育しやすいかも。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、竜族の一種。様々なエネルギー袋が融合しており、口からは混沌のブレスを吐く。好き嫌いがなく何でもよく食べるので飼育しやすいかも。"
en: A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. It has various energy sacks fused together and breathes chaos breath from its mouth. They have no likes or dislikes and eat everything well, so they may be easy to breed.
en_grezzo: "A type of dragon tribe with a fondness for the ether. It has various energy sacks fused together and breathes chaos breath from its mouth. They have no likes or dislikes and eat everything well, so they may be easy to breed."
it: Una specie della stirpe dei draghi, con un debole per l'etere. Ha diverse sacche di energia fuse insieme, e dalla bocca sputa un soffio di caos. Non ha gusti difficili e mangia di tutto con appetito: forse è facile da allevare.

jp: 3つの頭を持つ獣。各々の頭が交代で眠るのだが、火を吐く頭がストライキを起こし怠けているため、最近は魔法属性ブレスを吐く頭が頑張っている。
jp_grezzo: "3つの頭を持つ獣。各々の頭が交代で眠るのだが、火を吐く頭がストライキを起こし怠けているため、最近は魔法属性ブレスを吐く頭が頑張っている。"
en: A beast with three heads. Each head sleeps in turn, but the fire-breathing head is on strike and lazy, so the head that breathes magical breath has been working hard recently.
en_grezzo: "A beast with three heads. Each head sleeps in turn, but the fire-breathing head is on strike and lazy, so the head that breathes magical breath has been working hard recently. "
it: Una bestia con tre teste. Le teste dormono a turno, ma quella che sputa fuoco è in sciopero e batte la fiacca, e così ultimamente tocca darsi da fare a quella che sputa il soffio magico.

jp: 針のついた大きな尾が特徴的な節足動物。見た目は恐ろしいがそれほど毒は強くなく、殻も意外と柔らかい。結構美味しいとかで食料にもされている。
jp_grezzo: "針のついた大きな尾が特徴的な節足動物。見た目は恐ろしいがそれほど毒は強くなく、殻も意外と柔らかい。結構美味しいとかで食料にもされている。"
en: An arthropod characterised by a large tail with needles. They look fearsome but are not very poisonous and their shells are surprisingly soft. They are also used as food, as they are said to be quite tasty.
en_grezzo: "An arthropod characterised by a large tail with needles. They look fearsome but are not very poisonous and their shells are surprisingly soft. They are also used as food, as they are said to be quite tasty."
it: Un artropode che si riconosce per la coda grossa con il pungiglione. All'aspetto fa paura, ma il veleno non è poi così forte e anche il guscio è sorprendentemente morbido. Dicono sia parecchio buono, e infatti lo si mangia.

jp: 体こそ大きいが力はあまり強くないため、狩りは相変わらず毒頼み。体内の半分以上を毒の生成器官に変えており、その毒はインド象をも簡単に毒殺する。
jp_grezzo: "体こそ大きいが力はあまり強くないため、狩りは相変わらず毒頼み。体内の半分以上を毒の生成器官に変えており、その毒はインド象をも簡単に毒殺する。"
en: Although large in size, they are not very strong, so hunting is still dependent on poison. More than half of its body has been converted into poison-producing organs, and its venom can easily poison an Indian elephant.
en_grezzo: "Although large in size, they are not very strong, so hunting is still dependent on poison. More than half of its body has been converted into poison-producing organs, and its venom can easily poison an Indian elephant. "
it: Il corpo è grande, ma la forza non è granché, e per cacciare si affida come sempre al veleno. Più di metà del corpo l'ha convertito in organi che producono veleno, e quel veleno avvelena senza fatica perfino un elefante indiano.

jp: まだらに彩られた体は毒々しく、警戒心を煽るが、その見た目に反して毒は持たない。糸で獲物を絡め取り餌にしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "まだらに彩られた体は毒々しく、警戒心を煽るが、その見た目に反して毒は持たない。糸で獲物を絡め取り餌にしてしまう。"
en: Its mottled body is poisonous and alarming, but despite its appearance it is not poisonous. It uses threads to entangle its prey and feed on them.
en_grezzo: "Its mottled body is poisonous and alarming, but despite its appearance it is not poisonous. It uses threads to entangle its prey and feed on them. "
it: Il corpo screziato ha colori che sembrano velenosi e mettono in guardia, ma a dispetto dell'aspetto veleno non ne ha. Impiglia la preda nei fili e se la mangia.

jp: 蜘蛛の中でも細身で、艶かしく黒い肢体から女性を連想する者も多い。危険な毒を隠し持っていることもその一因となっているかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "蜘蛛の中でも細身で、艶かしく黒い肢体から女性を連想する者も多い。危険な毒を隠し持っていることもその一因となっているかもしれない。"
en: Many associate them with women because of their slender, shiny, black limbs, which are among the most slender of spiders. This may be partly due to the fact that they carry dangerous hidden venom.
en_grezzo: "Many associate them with women because of their slender, shiny, black limbs, which are among the most slender of spiders. This may be partly due to the fact that they carry dangerous hidden venom. "
it: Fra i ragni è di corporatura sottile, e in molti, guardando quelle zampe nere e lucide, pensano a una donna. Forse ci mette del suo anche il fatto che nasconda un veleno pericoloso.

jp: 神経に作用する毒を持った蜘蛛。獲物を見つけると、まずは麻痺毒を流し込み、動けなくなった所を後で食べやすいように細かく削っていく。
jp_grezzo: "神経に作用する毒を持った蜘蛛。獲物を見つけると、まずは麻痺毒を流し込み、動けなくなった所を後で食べやすいように細かく削っていく。"
en: A spider with a venom that acts on nerves. When it finds prey, it first pours paralysing venom into it and then shaves the immobilised parts into small pieces for easier eating later.
en_grezzo: "A spider with a venom that acts on nerves. When it finds prey, it first pours paralysing venom into it and then shaves the immobilised parts into small pieces for easier eating later. "
it: Un ragno che ha un veleno che agisce sui nervi. Quando trova una preda le versa dentro per prima cosa il veleno paralizzante, e poi la sminuzza dove non si muove più, così da mangiarla comoda in seguito.

jp: 毒を持つ蜘蛛といえば真っ先に連想されるであろう程有名。意外と愛らしい見た目をしている、などと評されることも稀にある。剛毛なのを気にしているとかいないとか。
jp_grezzo: "毒を持つ蜘蛛といえば真っ先に連想されるであろう程有名。意外と愛らしい見た目をしている、などと評されることも稀にある。剛毛なのを気にしているとかいないとか。"
en: It is so well known that it is probably the first thing people associate with poisonous spiders. They are rarely described as being surprisingly adorable looking. They may or may not be bothered by their bristly hair.
en_grezzo: "It is so well known that it is probably the first thing people associate with poisonous spiders. They are rarely described as being surprisingly adorable looking. They may or may not be bothered by their bristly hair."
it: È tanto famosa che, a dire ragno velenoso, è la prima a cui si pensa. Di rado c'è perfino chi la descrive come sorprendentemente graziosa. Che poi ci tenga o no ad avere il pelo ispido, non si sa.

jp: 生物の血液を好んで摂取する特異な種。糸を使って捕まえた獲物の体液を干からびるまで吸い尽す。シワシワになった生物の亡骸があれば、こいつの仕業だろう。
jp_grezzo: "生物の血液を好んで摂取する特異な種。糸を使って捕まえた獲物の体液を干からびるまで吸い尽す。シワシワになった生物の亡骸があれば、こいつの仕業だろう。"
en: A peculiar species of spider that likes to consume the blood of living creatures. It uses its threads to suck up the bodily fluids of its prey until it dries up. If there is a wrinkled corpse of a creature, it is probably the work of this one.
en_grezzo: "A peculiar species of spider that likes to consume the blood of living creatures. It uses its threads to suck up the bodily fluids of its prey until it dries up. If there is a wrinkled corpse of a creature, it is probably the work of this one."
it: Una specie particolare che si nutre volentieri del sangue delle creature vive. Con i fili cattura la preda e le succhia i liquidi del corpo finché non si secca. Se trovi il cadavere raggrinzito di una bestia, è opera sua.

jp: 樹木の体躯を持つ。過去の文献には制作主の命令に従う存在と書かれているのだが、いったい誰の命令でネフィアを守っているのだろうか。
jp_grezzo: "樹木の体躯を持つ。過去の文献には制作主の命令に従う存在と書かれているのだが、いったい誰の命令でネフィアを守っているのだろうか。"
en: They have the body of a tree. In past literature, they are described as beings who follow the orders of their creator, but whose orders are they protecting Nefia?
en_grezzo: "They have the body of a tree. In past literature, they are described as beings who follow the orders of their creator, but whose orders are they protecting Nefia?"
it: Ha un corpo d'albero. Nei testi antichi si legge che obbedisce agli ordini di chi l'ha costruito, ma per ordine di chi starà a fare la guardia alle Nefia?

jp: 額に異国の言葉で書かれた文字を消せばその機能を止めると言われているが、まともに対峙すればとてもそんな物を狙う余裕は無いだろう。
jp_grezzo: "額に異国の言葉で書かれた文字を消せばその機能を止めると言われているが、まともに対峙すればとてもそんな物を狙う余裕は無いだろう。"
en: It is said that erasing the writing on its forehead in an foreign language will stop its function, but there would be very little time to aim for such an object if confronted properly.
en_grezzo: "It is said that erasing the writing on its forehead in an foreign language will stop its function, but there would be very little time to aim for such an object if confronted properly. "
it: Si dice che cancellandogli dalla fronte i caratteri scritti in una lingua straniera se ne fermi la funzione, ma trovandoselo davvero davanti non ci sarà proprio il tempo di mirare a una cosa del genere.

jp: 錬鉄の体躯を持つ。素材を頑強な物にしているのは頻繁な戦闘を想定しているためであり、それに見合う高い戦闘能力を持っている。弱点は関節部。
jp_grezzo: "錬鉄の体躯を持つ。素材を頑強な物にしているのは頻繁な戦闘を想定しているためであり、それに見合う高い戦闘能力を持っている。弱点は関節部。"
en: They have a wrought iron physique. The material used to make it is robust because it is designed for frequent combat, and it has a high level of combat ability to match. Its weaknesses are its joints.
en_grezzo: "They have a wrought iron physique. The material used to make it is robust because it is designed for frequent combat, and it has a high level of combat ability to match. Its weaknesses are its joints."
it: Ha un corpo di ferro battuto. Il materiale l'hanno fatto robusto perché è pensato per combattere spesso, e in effetti ha una capacità di combattimento all'altezza. Il punto debole sono le giunture.
